metadata.case_name: KHAN SHAFIQ v. CHENG HIP MING

source: Mr. Khan sustained lower back sprain injury during the work accident.
Therefore, Mr Khan essentially sustained sprain injury of soft tissues with aggravation of his pre-existing early degenerative L5/S1 disc.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: early degenerative L5/S1 disc with mild bulging (aggravation of pre-existing condition)
source: Subsequent MRI scan showed essentially early degenerative changes of the L5/S1 disc with mild bulging without nerve root compression.
Disc bulging was recognised to be degenerative in origin, not caused by trauma.
Therefore, Mr Khan essentially sustained sprain injury of soft tissues with aggravation of his pre-existing early degenerative L5/S1 disc.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: No strength in his lower back when he tried to walk
Mild residual back pain possibly with exacerbation from time to time upon heavy exertion or prolonged walking

treatments_received: He was admitted to the Tuen Mun Hospital from 26th to 30th August 2005.
Subsequent MRI scan (date not specified) and medical report dated 22nd March 2007.

losses.description: He is expected to have mild residual back pain and "must be losing some comfort in the rest of his life with the injury he suffered in his back."
